messages.subject: Return Request – Order L-38204
messages.text:
Hi,

 

 
I purchased a cooler bag from your company, and after wearing it only once, it has already broken. My order number is Commande L-38204. I’ve attached a picture to show the defect.

 

 
Could you please let me know my options for a return or exchange?

 

 
Thank you,

 

 
Nataliya Soboleva

messages.subject: Re: Return Request – Order L-38204
messages.text:
Hi nataliya,
 

 We have received your message and are doing our utmost to respond and assist you as quickly as possible. It's a busy time for messages, and our customer service team is still quite small: just 1 full-time person and me, who helps out occasionally amidst my dozens of other tasks!
 

 Rest assured, however, that your situation will not be overlooked, and we will take care of it as soon as possible. It is understood that the return period applies from the time the customer notifies us of a desire to make an exchange or a refund, not from when we have time to respond. Serving our customers well is a high priority for us, even if we are sometimes a bit overwhelmed.
 

 In short, we haven't forgotten about you and we're working hard to not let you down!

messages.subject: Re: Return Request – Order L-38204
messages.text:
Hello Nataliya,
 

 Sorry for the longer than usual response time. We have not forgotten about you.
 

 We are sorry to learn that the cooler backpack you ordered has a quality defect.
 

 Concerned about our customers' satisfaction, we will reship the cooler backpack today. Please note that a label for the return of the defective backpack will be included in the package so that you can send it back to us.
 

 We remain at your disposal for any information, and we will be pleased to help you.
 

 Warmly,
 __
 Véronique 
 Customer Service 
 Lasclay
